Key facts stated by the site:
- Pricing is agreed before work starts.
- Carpet cleaning uses professional hot water extraction / steam cleaning.
- Typical carpet drying time is about 4–8 hours depending on thickness, humidity, and airflow.
- Pet odor and urine treatment is available as a dedicated service.
- Commercial carpet cleaning is available for offices and commercial spaces.
- Carpet stretching and repair addresses wrinkles, buckling, and some loose seams when the carpet remains serviceable.
- Water-damage service focuses on extraction and drying for affected carpets and floors.
- Hardwood cleaning uses controlled moisture and finish-conscious methods for sealed floors.

Service areas: Milwaukee, Wauwatosa, Brookfield, New Berlin, West Allis, Greenfield, Franklin, Muskego, Pewaukee, Oak Creek, Elm Grove, Hales Corners, and Greendale, Wisconsin.
